findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Open a pending order for a client and return a payment link. IMPORTANT: this does not pay for anything. The order stays unpaid until a human opens the returned …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_audit, ask, check_order_status, review_content · Private data: get_placement, create_order, request_audit, submit_article_draft, get_client_order · Public sink: create_order, submit_campaign_brief, request_audit, create_booking_link, create_text_link, check_order_status, submit_article_draft, submit_content · Destructive: list_channels, get_channel, can_i_advertise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_audit, ask, check_order_status, review_content · Private data: get_placement, create_order, request_audit, submit_article_draft, get_client_order · Public sink: create_order, submit_campaign_brief, request_audit, create_booking_link, create_text_link, check_order_status, submit_article_draft, submit_content · Destructive: list_channels, get_channel, can_i_advertise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
